app.name: GodGo
sidebar.reveal: Show the Project in the Finder
module.overview.title: Overview
module.overview.body: GodGo is the technical shell later apps keep. The window, sidebar, settings, signed updates and workflows are already wired. Put behavior in backend, the interface in frontend, and fonts, icons and copy in resources. The interface contract is Spec.
module.spec.title: Spec
module.spec.summary: The interface contract, as this Markdown file
module.spec.body: How the interface is drawn, and which components to reuse, are the two Markdown files below.
spec.missing: This spec file was not found.
module.workflow.title: Workflow
module.workflow.body: Tasks are classified as verify or release. Commands live in resources/workflow/tasks.json and the shell runs them directly, not through a shell. Releases use .github/workflows.
module.updates.title: Updates
module.updates.body: mygo build signs each platform's update with the private key. The app checks that signature against the public key built into it, then replaces itself. Settings choose automatic checks and automatic install. Before you publish, replace the public key in mygo.json with the one from mygo keygen.
module.fonts.title: Fonts
module.fonts.body: The interface uses the bundled Inter, an Apple-like Latin face, and Noto Sans SC for Simplified Chinese. Glyphs missing from Inter fall through to Noto Sans SC. Both are static SIL OFL 1.1 subsets, and the licenses ship beside them.
module.icons.title: Icons
module.icons.body: Sidebar and settings icons live in resources/icons. The line icons are Framework7's; the check and the chevrons are Lucide's. Add an SVG there and the file name is the name the code asks for.
module.testdata.title: Test resources
module.testdata.body: testdata is split into settings, workflow, copy, fonts and interface. Settings fixtures cover a valid file, an unknown key and a bad enum. Workflow fixtures cover a legal classification and an unknown group. The font manifest checks the checksums of the bundled files.
module.backend.title: Backend
module.backend.body: backend does not know about windows. settings reads and writes the configuration, workflow parses and runs tasks, modules is the sidebar's registry, and i18n reads the catalogs. Add a capability here, then show it in the interface.
module.frontend.title: Frontend
module.frontend.body: frontend draws the windows with MyGo 0.6. The sidebar, the settings window and the controls follow Kero. To add a settings page, register it in settingsPages and write its function.
extend.title: Extend this shell
extend.detail: Register in three places, and the next project keeps the same window, settings and release.
extend.modules: Sidebar module: backend/modules/modules.go, plus both catalogs.
extend.workflow: Workflow task: resources/workflow/tasks.json. A group must be one the file declares.
quit.title: Quit GodGo?
quit.detail: The window's place is remembered. This shell has no background work to stop.
palette.placeholder: Go to a module, setting or command
settings.title: Settings
set.openAtLogin.detail: Open GodGo after you log in. A development copy may have no app bundle, and the system will refuse.
set.confirmQuit.detail: Confirm when the last window closes.
set.restore.detail: Come back to the sidebar item that was selected.
set.vibrancy.detail: Use the system material under the sidebar. A desktop that asks for less transparency still gets a solid base.
set.font.detail: The bundled fonts are Inter and Noto Sans SC. The system font is the desktop's own.
set.scale.detail: How many times the usual size text is.
set.autoCheck.detail: Look at the signed GitHub releases in the background.
set.autoInstall.detail: Download a new version and switch to it the next time the app starts.
set.updatesNote: The release repository and the public key are in mygo.json. The private key stays on your machine and in CI.
set.runOnSave.detail: The shell records this convention. While it is on, saving settings runs the test task in the verify group.
set.notifyUpdate: Notify When an Update Is Available
set.notifyUpdate.detail: Tell you when a check finds a new version.
set.notifyDone.detail: Tell you when a task succeeds.
set.notifyFail.detail: Tell you when a task fails.
set.notifySound.detail: Play the system sound with the notification.
set.notifyUnsupported: This way of running cannot send system notifications. A packaged app can.
set.shortcut.detail: Press Return to keep what you typed. Leave it empty to unbind.
set.reset.detail: Restores general, appearance, updates, workflow and notifications. The window's place stays.
set.moduleRoot.none: No go.mod was found, so workflow tasks will not run.
task.noRoot: Open GodGo from the source directory to run tasks.
home.ready: The shell is wired. Pick a module on the left, or press ⌘K to jump.
